mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 77 degrees near the Verona Public Library, and we have a Waning Gibbous moon lighting up the night. If you look toward the northwest over the high school at 4:17 AM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling low across the sky toward Fitchburg. Overnight, we will see a low of 70 degrees, and there is no rain expected.

The Verona Senior Center is scheduled for a flooring replacement beginning September 1. Programming will be limited to wellness appointments and outdoor activities until September 4, with a closure on Labor Day. Regular programming resumes September 11. Additionally, crews are currently responding to a water main break near Todd Street, so please use caution in that area.

We have plenty happening in town. Yoga at Insight Wellness is today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, join us for more trivia at Paddy Mac's or the Bogey Factory on September 2, and catch the weekly downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park on September 2.

In a significant report from August 25, Verona Police officers were dispatched to Enterprise Drive for a medical emergency. An officer utilized a department-issued AED to provide a shock, which allowed the patient to regain a pulse before EMS arrival.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the crowd-pleasing Turtle Dove. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 50 minutes, so we encourage you to head over now if you want to pick up a treat.
